preparation_and_implementation.reason: Directed review, implementation and documentation ran concurrently in several work streams; assigning additive wall seconds would fabricate precision.

analysis.reason: Contrasts, documentation and source review overlapped implementation and validation; their provenance is retained by artifacts rather than an invented additive duration.

validation.basis: validation logs and timed clean rebuild from the first staged archive

packaging.basis: timed pre-publication stage and independent verifier run
packaging.note: Atomic publication occurs after archive content is frozen and therefore is not self-recorded inside that same immutable archive.

concurrency_note: Category wall times overlap and must not be summed to infer total effort.
